oracles.stack-profile-auditor: Architecture, locality, module depth, interfaces, state, data fetching, and platform-boundary evidence declared by a selected stack profile.
oracles.react-doctor: React component composition, hooks, rendering, and React-specific performance evidence.
oracles.lint: Syntax, style, forbidden TypeScript escape syntax, and repository-declared static rules.
oracles.typecheck: Type compatibility and inference across owned TypeScript boundaries.
oracles.focused-tests: Observable behavior of the changed surface and its regression contract.
oracles.impeccable: Visual hierarchy, responsive behavior, accessibility craft, and interaction polish; it does not own functional correctness.
oracles.codex-security: General trust boundaries, secrets, permissions, injection, and data-exposure risk outside Convex-specific function rules.
oracles.convex-review: Convex authorization, validators, indexes, pagination, bounded reads, contention, actions, scheduling, storage, and component selection.
oracles.provider-checks: Provider-specific configuration and runtime constraints that cannot be proven by a stack-neutral oracle.

react-effects.title: You Might Not Need an Effect

dimensions.modules: Deep feature modules behind small component interfaces.
dimensions.state: Derive values during render; effects synchronize external systems.
dimensions.dataFetching: Keep server state outside ad hoc effects.
dimensions.platformBoundaries: Browser and server APIs stay behind narrow adapters.

dimensions.composition: Compose router, query, table, and form capabilities independently.
dimensions.performance: Use cache and stale semantics intentionally.
dimensions.locality: Keep query options and route contracts near features.
dimensions.modules: Hide library mechanics behind domain-facing modules.
dimensions.interfaces: Preserve inferred route and query types.
dimensions.state: Separate server, URL, form, and client state.
dimensions.dataFetching: Use stable query keys and explicit invalidation.
dimensions.platformBoundaries: Keep loaders and runtime adapters explicit.

dimensions.composition: Packages expose coherent capabilities rather than shared dumping grounds.
dimensions.performance: Cache only deterministic tasks with declared inputs and outputs.
dimensions.locality: Package configuration follows the package that owns it.
dimensions.modules: Workspace packages have deep contracts and narrow exports.
dimensions.state: Generated and cached state stays distinguishable from source.
dimensions.platformBoundaries: Environment variables and platform tasks are explicit inputs.

dimensions.composition: Own generated components and compose them locally.
dimensions.performance: Review update diffs before accepting new dependencies or markup.
dimensions.locality: Keep registry provenance and local modifications visible.
dimensions.modules: Wrap repeated product behavior, not primitive access.
dimensions.state: Keep interaction state in the owning feature.
dimensions.dataFetching: UI primitives do not own domain fetching.
dimensions.platformBoundaries: Registry, icon family, and primitive-family choices are repository declarations.

dimensions.composition: Functions compose domain capabilities with explicit auth.
dimensions.performance: Use indexes, pagination, bounded reads, and contention-aware writes.
dimensions.locality: Schema, validators, and functions follow domain ownership.
dimensions.modules: Expose small validated function interfaces over deep domain modules.
dimensions.interfaces: Every public function validates arguments and return values.
dimensions.state: Domain records and relationships stay in Convex.
dimensions.dataFetching: Queries are reactive, indexed, bounded, and paginated where needed.
dimensions.platformBoundaries: Actions, scheduling, storage, and official components are explicit boundaries.

dimensions.composition: Workers and bindings expose narrow provider adapters.
dimensions.performance: Cache and storage choices follow measured access patterns.
dimensions.locality: Provider configuration stays beside its adapter.
dimensions.modules: Domain code does not depend directly on runtime globals.
dimensions.state: Suitable binary and static objects use R2; domain relationships remain in the domain store.
dimensions.dataFetching: External fetches have explicit caching, limits, and failure behavior.
dimensions.platformBoundaries: Runtime, bindings, destinations, and credentials remain explicit.

dimensions.composition: Shared React Native features preserve platform-specific seams.
dimensions.performance: Protect JS and UI frame budgets and measure native-boundary work.
dimensions.locality: Screen state and platform adapters stay feature-local.
dimensions.modules: Use deep feature modules with narrow native interfaces.
dimensions.interfaces: Native modules and permissions have typed adapters.
dimensions.state: Separate navigation, server, form, and device state.
dimensions.dataFetching: Account for offline, retry, lifecycle, and constrained networks.
dimensions.platformBoundaries: Use Expo/React Native by default for new mobile work; eject or add native code only for a concrete capability.

dimensions.composition: Compose SwiftUI views from explicit feature models.
dimensions.performance: Measure responsiveness, launch, memory, and main-thread work.
dimensions.locality: Observable state belongs at the narrowest owning level.
dimensions.modules: Frameworks and packages expose small Swift interfaces.
dimensions.interfaces: Protocols represent real varying adapters, not speculative seams.
dimensions.state: Use one clear source of truth for model data.
dimensions.dataFetching: Networking, persistence, cancellation, and lifecycle are explicit.
dimensions.platformBoundaries: Entitlements, privacy, background work, and native APIs remain visible.

dimensions.composition: Compose UI consumes unidirectional feature state.
dimensions.performance: Measure startup, recomposition, frame timing, and memory.
dimensions.locality: UI and data layers retain clear ownership.
dimensions.interfaces: Repositories and platform services expose small contracts.
dimensions.state: Use lifecycle-aware observable state and a single source of truth.
dimensions.dataFetching: Offline, caching, paging, cancellation, and retries are intentional.
dimensions.platformBoundaries: Permissions, services, background work, and device APIs use adapters.

dimensions.composition: Renderer, preload, and main process have separate responsibilities.
dimensions.performance: Measure startup, renderer work, IPC, and memory.
dimensions.locality: Desktop integrations stay behind feature-owned IPC adapters.
dimensions.modules: Main-process capabilities expose narrow preload interfaces.
dimensions.interfaces: IPC channels are explicit, validated, and least-privilege.
dimensions.state: Renderer UI state and privileged process state remain separated.
dimensions.dataFetching: Network and filesystem access occur in the appropriate process.
dimensions.platformBoundaries: Context isolation, sandboxing, navigation, permissions, and code loading are explicit.
